policies.artifact_immutability: Never replace a previous model version in place. Commit every new candidate under unique version/hash path.
policies.no_media_upload: Do not commit WAV, BMP, annotations, site locations, reviewer paths, credentials or training dataset.
policies.retrain_trigger: Future opt-in daily scheduler; currently NOT automatically retraining or publishing.
policies.model_promotion: No automatic champion replacement. Review validation, held-out night stability, shadow field tests, and human approval first.
policies.device_delivery: Model-only Wi-Fi OTA is a future firmware feature, not present in current RT or SD firmware. Require device/runtime compatibility, signed manifest, SHA-256 verification, A/B atomic activation, and rollback.
policies.unsafe_format: joblib is Python pickle-based; only trusted model artifacts should be loaded. For ESP32 generate a restricted numeric representation, not pickle.
policies.training_data: Original human annotations stay local. A versioned dataset hash/manifest can be published without the recordings.
